summary: Swarmer, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to disclose that, as of August 19, 2026, it had 15,936,981 shares outstanding after issuing 3,997,762 shares upon exercise of stock options. No corporate transaction, strategic review, tender offer, or other special situation is involved. The filing is a routine disclosure of share count and option exercises, typical of a plain 8-K event. No deal terms, pricing, or structural considerations apply. No further action or risk-arbitrage angle is warranted; the event is informational only.
